notes.title: Update to Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
- Added "Production and Supervisor Lily Production" to the credits.
- Added "Default" button to system page of config. (Does not affect resolution and window mode)
- Added "Display Time Played" to config.
- Fixed a bug where the framerate display was not affected by "Exclude UI from capture".
- Reduced the drawing load of the ending city scene.
- Fixed a bug where the achievements of "Shishinoke", "Kyoto-O", "Kankandara", "Couple Ghost", "Deity of the Mountains", "Skanda", "Emergency Evasion", and "Chibiki-no-iwa" could not be obtained.

notes.title: Updated to Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where achievement unlock information was not sent to Steam.
- Corrected the achievement icon for "Cute Things".
- Added a voice during battle to the deity of the mountains.
- Fixed the particle color when the deity of the mountains shrinks.
- Include ChangeLog and MaterialList.
